description:
Get OHLC candles for a symbol. Returns open/high/low/close buckets for an asset over a configurable
lookback window, sampled at a configurable resolution. Use for
candlestick charts and volatility measures that need the intra-bucket
range rather than a single close.

Only sources that store individual ticks can produce OHLC. Requesting
candles for an asset priced from a derived or snapshot source returns
`400`.

See the [Time Window & Resolution](#section/Time-Window-and-Resolution)
section for the format of `window` and `resolution`.

as_of.description: Ends the window at this instant instead of now, so a past period can be read. RFC3339, and not the zero time. A future instant bounds a window that is still filling. Absent reads live data.

asset_class.description: Asset class to resolve the symbol in. Defaults to `spot` (one of: spot, perp)

asset_id.description: Backend asset ID. Mutually exclusive with `symbol`: exactly one of the two is required, and naming both is a 400.

symbol.description: Asset symbol to fetch candles for (e.g. `SOL`, `BTC`).

name: get_candles
